sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Grenade box is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Grenade boxes are 3x2 loot containers that only spawn grenades, UZRGM grenade fuze and TP-200 TNT brick.
